## Before opening this pull request

DECC is currently not accepting unsolicited code contributions by default.

Please continue only if a maintainer explicitly requested this change. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Summary

Describe the requested change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] The change matches the maintainer-requested scope.
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes.
- [ ] macOS and Windows behavior were considered where relevant.
- [ ] No local-only files or project-specific data are included.
- [ ] No licensing, telemetry, cloud-service, or distribution changes were introduced unintentionally.
